source_institution_authors: University of Dschang (Cameroon) & IPSA (France); Emmanuel Moupojou, Appolinaire Tagne, Florent Retraint, et al.
relevant_classes_available: Tomato Healthy, Tomato Leaf Mosaic Virus, Tomato Leaf Yellow Virus. (Bacterial Wilt & Brown Spots present but biologically distinct; Blight Leaf generic).
imaging_environment: In-situ field photography on agricultural smallholder plantations in Cameroon; natural sunlight, soil, weeds, canopy clutter
originality_status: Original field collection. Supervised by plant pathologists (FASA). WARNING: Do NOT use third-party 'Combined PV-PD-FP' mirrors.
benchmark_collision_risk: Low prior risk. Mandatory SHA-256 screening against all 9,921 protected benchmark files required prior to acquisition.
status_and_suitability: APPROVED FOR SHORTLIST (Tomato). Legitimately supplies 3 canonical classes: Healthy, Mosaic Virus, Yellow Leaf Curl Virus. Does NOT supply Spider Mites, Target Spot, Leaf Mold, Septoria, or Late Blight.

dataset_name: GVLiD: GrapeVine Leaf identification of Diseases (Shikalgar et al., 2024)
source_institution_authors: Annasaheb Dange College of Engg. & Tech. (ADCET), Sangli, Maharashtra; Shikalgar, Savalkar, Bhasme, Chavan, Nikam
relevant_classes_available: Healthy (1048), Black rot (758), Esca (832), Leaf blight (839)
imaging_environment: In-situ vineyard photography in Sangli, Maharashtra (1080x1080 resolution)
originality_status: IDENTICAL TO EXISTING INTERNAL G2. Locally verified: grape_2024 directory contains exact same 3,477 files (1080x1080) across Black rot (808), esca (888), healthy (1109), leaf blight (672).
benchmark_collision_risk: FATAL AS EXTERNAL SOURCE: Already part of our internal training baseline (splits/grape_unified/train.csv).
status_and_suitability: INTERNAL / ALREADY USED. Disqualified from external acquisition. GVLiD is already our production G2 dataset.

dataset_name: HERMOS: Visual Detection of Grape Leaf Diseases (Özacar et al., 2024)
source_institution_authors: Manisa Celal Bayar Univ. & Ege Univ., Turkey; Tuğba Özacar, Övünç Öztürk, Nurdan Güngör Savaş
relevant_classes_available: Powdery Mildew, Downy Mildew, Healthy Leaves (Fourth class: Dead Arm / Phomopsis viticola)
imaging_environment: In-situ vineyard photography in Gediz River Basin, West Anatolia, Turkey; natural outdoor lighting, complex vineyard background
originality_status: Original standalone field dataset. Annotations provided with Pascal VOC bounding boxes for region-level or full-leaf classification.
benchmark_collision_risk: Low prior risk (independent Turkish collection). Mandatory SHA-256 screening required before acquisition.
status_and_suitability: APPROVED FOR SHORTLIST (Grape). Strongly suitable for missing/failing classes: Powdery Mildew (0 in Track C, 3.3% acc), Downy Mildew (4.0% acc), and Healthy foliage.

source_institution_authors: Polytechnic Univ. of Marche & STMicroelectronics, Italy; Michele Alessandrini et al.
imaging_environment: In-situ vineyard canopy in Marche, Italy; natural outdoor lighting
originality_status: Original standalone dataset. (Note: Later incorporated into FieldVitis, but the original Mendeley repository 89cnxc58kj.1 is standalone and unmixed).
benchmark_collision_risk: Low prior risk. Mandatory SHA-256 screening required before acquisition.
status_and_suitability: APPROVED AS SUPPLEMENTARY (Grape). Useful for independent European Esca and Healthy diversity. Limited to 2 classes.

dataset_name: Merlot Downy Mildew In-Situ Dataset (Phénix et al., 2022)
source_institution_authors: INRAE & Bordeaux Sciences Agro, France; Sylvain Phénix et al.
imaging_environment: In-situ vineyard foliage in Bordeaux, France (Merlot cultivar)
benchmark_collision_risk: Low prior risk. Mandatory SHA-256 screening required before acquisition.
status_and_suitability: APPROVED AS SUPPLEMENTARY (Grape). Targeted for Downy Mildew field diversity. Small sample size (99 images).

source_institution_authors: Global Biodiversity Information Facility & California Academy of Sciences; Citizen Scientists & Verified Botanists
license: Filterable: CC0 and CC BY only
relevant_classes_available: Vitis vinifera foliage with leaf pathology (Targeted for Bacterial Leaf Spot: Xanthomonas spp.)
imaging_environment: Authentic outdoor real-world vineyard, farm, and wild environments globally
originality_status: Original observation stream; not derived from computer vision datasets.
benchmark_collision_risk: Low systematic risk. Mandatory SHA-256 screening required.
status_and_suitability: APPROVED AS TARGETED SOURCE (Grape Bacterial Leaf Spot). Specifically required because Bacterial Leaf Spot has ZERO field samples in all benchmarks and repositories. Requires manual visual pathology verification.

relevant_classes_available: Black rot, Esca, Leaf blight, Healthy
originality_status: AGGREGATED DATASET. Documentation explicitly confirms combination of ESCA-dataset, PlantDoc-Dataset, and Grape Disease datasets.
benchmark_collision_risk: FATAL. Contains PlantDoc, which directly contaminates Track B, Track C, and Chilli Exp 5 benchmarks.
status_and_suitability: DISQUALIFIED. Benchmark contamination risk via included PlantDoc images.

dataset_name: GLDD: Grape Leaf Disease Dataset (Liu et al., 2020)
source_institution_authors: Northwest A&F University, China; Liu et al.
relevant_classes_available: Black Rot, Esca, Leaf Blight, Downy Mildew, Healthy
imaging_environment: Vineyard mobile photography under natural lighting
benchmark_collision_risk: HIGH. 140 images already reside in held-out benchmarks (60 in Track B, 80 in Track C).
status_and_suitability: DEFERRED. Not acquired in this round due to active presence in Track B and Track C benchmarks.

source_institution_authors: IIT Bombay; Pratik Singh et al.
benchmark_collision_risk: FATAL. 180 images in Track B/C and 115 in Chilli Exp 5.
status_and_suitability: DISQUALIFIED. Active benchmark asset. Using for training causes direct evaluation leakage.

status_and_suitability: INTERNAL / ALREADY USED. Disqualified from external acquisition. Already our G1 baseline dataset.
